newsitem.title: USA: Weirton Steel Web site allows purchases.
newsitem.headline: Weirton Steel Web site allows purchases.

text.p: Weirton Steel said on Monday customers can now order steel on-line 24 hours day from anywhere in the world through its World Wide Web site on the Internet.
The site (http://www.weirton.com) is updated daily and features an on-line product sales section where excess and non-prime steel products are available for purchase.
Customers must become registered users to buy products on-line, the company said. New customers will need to complete an on-line credit application.
The Web site will also contain data about the company's history, financial data, product information and answers to technical questions, Weirton said.
